description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Publisher entity, including methods to find a publisher by ID and to retrieve all publishers, with entity graph annotations for fetching associated books.

classes.name: PublisherRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Publisher entities, with custom entity graph annotations for fetching associated books.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Publisher by its ID, including associated books via entity graph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Publisher entities, including associated books via entity graph.
